description: CAT-B names outside tables, one element varied per attempt, DBEngine.Errors before and after each, collections refreshed. Fields appended with TableDef.CreateField/Fields.Append: Aa then aA (case duplicate), the accented pair U+00E9/U+00C9, a leading space, 'a.b', 'a!b', '[br]', a backquote, a trailing space, 64 and 65 characters. Indexes by CREATE INDEX: IxA then ixa (case duplicate), an accented pair, a 65-character name. Relations appended with CreateRelation: R1 then r1 on other columns (case duplicate), and a 65-character name. Asks whether the table-name rules (case-insensitive, 64 limit, invalid characters, trailing space kept) also hold in the field, index and relation namespaces.
